text:
Harper (CS): Heads-up — putting together a tiny activation handoff snippet AMs can paste in kickoff notes. Keep it under 6 lines and include a pasteable prefill + 3 quick checks.
Diego (Solutions): Love that. Could we add a one-line cost-safety suggestion and a lightweight feedback hook?
Harper (CS): Yes. Draft below — very paste-friendly.
Harper (CS): Pasteable customer blurb (1 line): "We ran a light, idempotent prefill to warm your templates and recent history so replies feel snappier. Reply if you'd rather we skip this."
Harper (CS): Pasteable checklist for AM notes: 
Harper (CS): - Prefill executed? (ts)
Harper (CS): - Warm pool reserved: 2 sessions for first 12–24h? (yes/no)
Harper (CS): - Feedback link sent & 5 sample prompts captured? (yes/no)
Sana (SRE): Ops guidance: set warm_pool.min=2 for the first 12–24h based on demo length. Run a healthcheck after pool creation: GET /healthz. Use idempotency_key on prefill to avoid duplicate token usage.
Diego (Solutions): One-line prefill (paste into terminal):
Diego (Solutions): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TRIAL_HANDOFF","idempotency_key":"handoff-3701112222","items":[{"type":"template","id":"hello_agent"},{"type":"history","last_n":15}]}'
```
Sana (SRE): Run prefill at most once per 48h for trial tenants to limit token burn. Keep last_n <= 20.
Yuri (PM): Renewal signal mapping (attach to the ticket):
Yuri (PM): - Day3 quick check: if query_count_day3 < 0.5 * avg(day1) then schedule a troubleshooting call.
Yuri (PM): - Day10 pulse: if active_users_day10 < 0.4 * avg(day1-3) OR avg_response_time_day10 > 1.5s then classify as "needs enablement" for the renewal playbook.
Harper (CS): Cost-safety tip for AMs: suggest customers enable low_cost_mode or set unit_cost_threshold; if exceeded, automatically route to quantized model or reduce max_tokens per response.
Sana (SRE): Alerts to wire: 5xx_rate > 0.6% OR streaming_error_rate > 1% OR p99_stream_latency > 1500ms -> notify #oncall-infra and tag the AM in the incident. Also emit a prefill_failure event per-tenant.
Diego (Solutions): Feedback link to paste for customers: https://redwood.ai/s/mini-feedback (1 question: "How was speed and relevance? short/ok/slow/poor").
Harper (CS): AM quick-paste snippet for kickoff notes: 
Harper (CS): - Customer blurb: [paste customer blurb]
Harper (CS): - Prefill: handoff-3701112222 (ran at: ___)
Harper (CS): - Warm pool: 2 sessions (expires: ___)
Harper (CS): - Feedback link sent: https://redwood.ai/s/mini-feedback
Diego (Solutions): Demo tip: if you need quiet alerts during a live demo, run: `mute-bot quiet deploys 20m tenant:TRIAL_HANDOFF`
mute-bot: OK — deploy alerts muted for 20 minutes for tenant:TRIAL_HANDOFF :white_check_mark:
Harper (CS): I'll add this 1-pager + curl to the CS snippets repo and link it into the renewal playbook as "Activation handoff (mini-prefill)". Thanks team. :seedling:
